subject: Request: concession for onboarding package & premium support — OrangePeak
messages:
From: Claire D'Souza <claire@orangepeak.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orangepeak.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: Initial: onboarding + premium support ask (SOW attached)

Hi Vivek / Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the platform looks like a great fit. Procurement asked me to get final commercial confirmation before we loop Legal. A couple of asks from OrangePeak that are blockers for signature: 

- Include Premium Support (24x7 phone + dedicated CSM) for the first 12 months in the onboarding bundle (added to SOW).
- Remove the milestone-based integration holdback (we prefer a single acceptance on delivery) — this is non-standard for them.
- Requesting a 25% one-time onboarding credit to offset the custom connector engineering cost.

I've attached an updated SOW (v3) and our internal onboarding runbook for reference. If Redwood can agree to the above, I can send a PO and fast-track signature. If not, this will need to go back to our CFO.

Thanks,
Claire D'Souza
Director, Strategic Programs
OrangePeak

Attachments: OrangePeak_SOW_draft_v3.pdf (application/pdf), Onboarding-Runbook.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Claire D'Souza <claire@orangepeak.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial: onboarding + premium support ask (SOW attached)

Claire — appreciate the clarity and the attachments. Quick summary from our side: 

- Premium Support: We can include the first 12 months of Premium Support (dedicated CSM + 24x7 coverage) as part of the onboarding bundle, but need internal approval on absorbing the first-year support cost.
- Milestone removal: Removing the integration holdback is a material terms change for our SOW/acceptance flow. Operations prefers staged acceptance, but Deal Desk can consider a single delivery acceptance with legal sign-off.
- 25% onboarding credit: That's above standard delegated authority. Requesting exec sign-off.

Marcus, can you run the numbers and push this to Deal Desk / Exec for a decision? I'm provisioning this as a concession ask. If we can land at ~20–22% credit and accept the single acceptance milestone (with a clause for remediation), I think we can close this quarter.

Claire — copying procurement so they're in the loop. Will follow up with a formal recommendation and the draft amendment for signature.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

On Mon, 02 Nov 2026 at 14:08, Claire D'Souza <claire@orangepeak.com> wrote:
> (previous message)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: concession request — recommendation for exec approval

Vivek / Lauren — quick deal desk readout after reviewing SOW v3 and cost tables: 

- Cost impact: Accepting 12 months Premium Support as included adds ~$62k NRR burden Year 1 (listed in spreadsheet).
- Onboarding credit: 25% equals ~$38k credit. We can cover up to 22% under Deal Desk authority; anything >22% needs Exec approval.
- Acceptance flow: Operations will accept a single delivery acceptance only if we add a 90-day remediation SLA and a short escrow-style clause for key integration deliverables. Legal will need to add a one-paragraph remediation right.

Recommendation for Exec: Approve a 22% one-time onboarding credit, include Premium Support Year 1, and modify acceptance to single delivery with 90-day remediation (documented in SOW amendment). With this concession, we push to close by 11/12 and capture Q4 ARR.

I've attached the cost workbook (Onboarding-Runbook.xlsx) and a redlined SOW summary.

Please approve or advise next steps.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Onboarding-Runbook.xlsx (cost workbook), OrangePeak_SOW_draft_v3.pdf (redlines)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 10:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: concession request — recommendation for exec approval

Vivek / Marcus — quick note from AE perspective: OrangePeak is fast-moving and has committed to a PO once terms are agreed. They are already scheduled for an integration kickoff the week of 11/15.

If Exec can sign off on the recommended 22% credit + Premium Support Year 1 + single acceptance with 90-day remediation, we should accept. The upside: $450k initial ARR, with clear expansion path in H1. The risk is absorbing Year 1 support cost, but that is offset by expected expansion.

Requesting final sign-off by COB 11/06 so I can instruct Legal/Finance to prepare the amendment and DocuSign.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

On Tue, 03 Nov 2026 at 09:10, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com> wrote:
> (deal desk recommendation)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Claire D'Souza <claire@orangepeak.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, procurement@orangepeak.com
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Final: Exec approval — OrangePeak onboarding concession (approved)

Claire — good news. Exec has approved a limited concession to close this quarter: 

- Approved concession: 22% one-time onboarding credit (applied to initial invoice).
- Premium Support: Redwood will include Premium Support for the first 12 months as part of the onboarding bundle.
- Acceptance: We will proceed with single delivery acceptance; SOW will include a 90-day remediation SLA and a short clause giving Redwood the right to remediate without refund for defined items.

Conditions: PO and signed SOW amendment required. Finance will issue an invoice reflecting the credit after receipt of PO. Legal will prepare the amendment and DocuSign link — please confirm the signatory name on your side so we can populate DocuSign.

Thanks for moving quickly on this — looking forward to kickoff.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

On Fri, 06 Nov 2026 at 17:05, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com> wrote:
> (request for exec sign-off)

From: Claire D'Souza <claire@orangepeak.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orangepeak.com, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 11:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final: Exec approval — OrangePeak onboarding concession (approved)

This is great news — thank you. Signatory will be Margaret Hsu (CFO). I'll have procurement send the PO today and we'll sign the DocuSign once received. Appreciate the flexibility and quick cadence.

Claire D'Souza
Director, Strategic Programs
OrangePeak

Attachments referenced earlier: OrangePeak_SOW_draft_v3.pdf, Onboarding-Runbook.xlsx
